sentences: I open the spreadsheet and click on cell A1 to start entering the quarterly sales figures.
I type a formula that sums the values in column B from row two through row fifty.
I select the entire row and apply bold formatting to the header labels.
I sort the data alphabetically by the customer name column in ascending order.
I filter the list to show only rows where the status column equals 'pending'.
I insert a new column between C and D to hold the calculated tax amounts.
I use the VLOOKUP function to find the price for each product code in the table.
I freeze the top row so the headers stay visible while I scroll down.
I create a pivot table to summarize total sales by region and month.
I apply conditional formatting to highlight cells greater than one thousand in red.
I check for circular references in the formulas and trace the precedents.
I merge the cells in the title row and center the text across the selection.
I set data validation on the date column to only accept entries from this year.
I copy the range of cells and paste them as values to remove the formulas.
I add a comment to cell F7 noting that the number needs verification.
I adjust the column widths so all the text fits without being cut off.
I rename the sheet tab from 'Sheet1' to 'Monthly Expenses' for the new fiscal year.
I use the SUMIF function to add up only the expenses in the travel category.
I protect the worksheet so that no one can edit the locked cells.
I save the file as a new version and check the revision history for changes.
